```{r dash-sla-disclaimer, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
# Only show the disclaimer if SLA was actually evaluated (no point showing it if no SLA exists at all)
has_any_sla <- (length(sla_results) > 0) || (length(rt_sla_results) > 0)

if (has_any_sla) {

  htmltools::tags$div(
    style = paste0(
      "background-color: #1e1e1e; ",
      "color: #FF6432; ",
      "border-left: 4px solid #FF6432; ",
      "border-radius: 4px; ",
      "padding: 12px 18px; ",
      "margin: 10px 0; ",
      "font-family: Consolas, monospace; ",
      "font-size: 12px; ",
      "line-height: 1.6;"
    ),
    htmltools::tags$span(style = "font-weight: bold;", "⚠ Note: "),
    "This SLA evaluation covers client-side metrics only (response time, error rate, ",
    "throughput, and virtual users). Server-side infrastructure metrics — CPU, memory, ",
    "and other resource utilisation — are not currently captured by this tool and ",
    "have not been verified against any threshold. A full performance sign-off should ",
    "include separate confirmation of server-side health from infrastructure monitoring."
  )

} else {
  htmltools::tags$div(style = "display: none;")
}
```
